如果此书侵犯了您的权益，请点击访问作者版权投诉快速通道    “楚月姐，你怎么出来了。”楚枫不解的问道。
而楚月则是笑嘻嘻的跑到楚枫身前，用那白皙的玉手，轻轻的在楚枫的胸口来了一拳，满脸欣喜的道：
“你小子行啊，我说你怎么在外门待得这么从容，搞了半天早就追上了我。”
楚枫尴尬的挠了挠头：“楚月姐，今日真是给你添麻烦了，我看你们这个楚盟聚会，也要不欢而散了。”
“没事，让他们长长教训也是好的，省着整日欺负你。”
“对了楚枫弟，明日灵药狩猎我们一起吧，那东西自己一个人很难抓到的。”
“算了吧，我和他们的关系你知道，就算我肯加入楚盟，他们也不肯。”楚枫摇了摇头。
“你别管了，这件事交给我处理，总之明日你来这里找我们便是。”楚月又将一张竹片塞给了楚枫，那上面是一个楚盟明日的聚集地点。
“好吧。”见楚月如此执着，楚枫也是实在不忍拒绝。
安抚好楚枫后，楚月便蹦蹦跳跳的向府邸走去，她真的很开心，因为楚枫今日给了她一个很大的惊喜。
天下之人皆以实力为尊，眼下楚枫展现出了不俗的实力，她觉得楚家人也许会认可楚枫。
而楚家能够团结一体，不分彼此，便是她最大的心愿。
“楚威大哥，你们...”可刚到府邸门前，楚月却发现楚盟的人，都已经走了出来。
“哼”楚成和楚真，狠狠的瞪了楚月一眼，二话不说便快步离去。
“楚月，不是我做大哥的说你，今日之事，你着实太过偏袒那楚枫了。”
“这下好，让那楚枫白白拿走了两株仙灵草不说，还让我等被他羞辱了一番，现在大家都被气走了，你满意了？”楚威严厉的斥责起来。
“楚威大哥，当是我错了还不行么，再怎么说楚枫弟也是咱楚家人。”
“你看，楚枫弟的实力你也见到了，他并不是你们眼中的废物，而我们楚盟正需人手，不如让他也加入我们楚盟吧。”
听得楚月这样一说，楚威顿时脸色一变，可刚要开口，眼中却闪现出一抹诡异，而后无奈的叹息道：
“哎，真是服了你这丫头”

“好吧，看在你的面子上，我就给他楚枫一次机会，明日你带他一同来吧。”
“太好了，就知道楚威大哥最好了。”楚月激动的跳了起来，笑的异常灿烂。
“好了，早点休息吧。”楚威摇了摇头，便向自己的府邸走去。
“楚威大哥也早点休息。”楚月笑着对楚威挥手，目送楚威离开。
楚威答应楚枫加入楚盟，这让楚月喜出望外，不过她却没有看到，楚威转身时，嘴角那阴险的笑容。
“楚月师姐，那个叫楚枫的隐藏的够深的，我在外门待了这么久，竟然没听过他的名字，看来他是奔着内门考核的第一名去的。”
就在这时，一名少年走了过来，他与楚枫一样，是今年的新生弟子，今日才加入楚盟的成员。
“你说的对，楚枫弟留在外门，一定是为了考核的奖励，也不知道他拿没拿到。”听他这样一说，楚月也是恍然大悟。
“楚月师姐你想多了，今年外门可出现了一个狠角色，那第一早就被那人拿走了。”
“你那个楚枫弟虽说实力也不错，不过和那人比，简直不入流。”少年笑道。
“狠角色？有多狠？”楚月好奇的问道。
“那可是相当狠了，一只四阶凶兽，九只三阶凶兽，三十只二阶凶兽，只是眨眼的功夫就全被他给屠了。”
“当外门那些天才弟子赶到的时候，看到的只有满地的凶兽尸体，这般实力，你说狠不狠?”
“这么厉害？”这一刻，楚月也是满脸的震惊。
她也是经历过内门考核的人，知道那机关阵的厉害，更知道凶兽的可怕。
而在所有人未能赶到前，便足以击杀那么多只凶兽，她完全可以想象，此人的实力是多么强悍，那至少需要灵武五重才能做到。
“那人叫什么？”震惊之余，楚月很想知道，这位狠角色的大名。
“哎，我也想知道他是谁。”
“不过可惜，那人有意隐瞒自己的身份，拿走奖励之后，并未头，便告辞离去。
“那这人还真是奇怪，这么厉害，还如此低调，莫非有什么不可告人的秘密？”

这一刻，楚月对那所谓的狠角色，越发好奇起来。

If this book infringes upon your rights, please click to visit the author's copyright complaint fast channel. "Sister Chu Yue, why did you come out?" Chu Feng asked in confusion.
Chu Yue, on the other hand, ran up to Chu Feng with a smile, used her white jade hands to lightly punch Chu Feng in the chest, and said with a face full of joy:
"You're good, kid. I asked you why you stayed so calmly at the outer gate. You've already caught up with me after a long time."
Chu Feng scratched his head in embarrassment: "Sister Chu Yue, I really caused you trouble today. I think your Chu Alliance gathering will break up on bad terms."
"It's okay. It's good to teach them a lesson so they don't have to bully you all day long."
"By the way, Brother Chu Feng, let's go hunting for elixirs together tomorrow. It's hard to catch that thing by yourself."
"Forget it, you know my relationship with them. Even if I am willing to join the Chu League, they will not." Chu Feng shook his head.
"Don't worry about it. Leave this matter to me. In short, you can come here to find us tomorrow." Chu Yue stuffed another piece of bamboo to Chu Feng. On it was a gathering place for the Chu Alliance tomorrow.
"Okay." Seeing Chu Yue's persistence, Chu Feng really couldn't bear to refuse.
After comforting Chu Feng, Chu Yue jumped towards the mansion. She was really happy because Chu Feng gave her a big surprise today.
Everyone in the world respects strength. Now that Chu Feng has shown good strength, she feels that the Chu family may recognize Chu Feng.
And it is her greatest wish that the Chu family can be united as one, regardless of each other.
"Brother Chu Wei, you..." But as soon as she arrived in front of the mansion, Chu Yue found that everyone from the Chu League had already walked out.
"Humph" Chu Cheng and Chu Zhen glared at Chu Yue fiercely and left quickly without saying a word.
"Chu Yue, it's not me who is the eldest brother, but what happened today is that you are too partial to Chu Feng."
"Okay, let's not forget that Chu Feng took away two fairy grasses for nothing, and let us be humiliated by him. Now everyone is angry and angry. Are you satisfied?" Chu Wei reprimanded sternly.
"Brother Chu Wei, why don't you just pretend that I'm wrong? No matter what, brother Chu Feng is also a member of our Chu family."
"Look, you have seen Brother Chu Feng's strength. He is not a waste in your eyes, and our Chu League is in need of manpower. Why not let him join our Chu League."
Hearing what Chu Yue said, Chu Wei's expression suddenly changed, but just as he was about to speak, a strange look flashed in his eyes, and then he sighed helplessly:
"Hey, I'm really impressed by you, girl."
"Okay, for your sake, I will give him Chu Feng a chance. You can bring him with you tomorrow."
"Great, I know Brother Chu Wei is the best." Chu Yue jumped up excitedly, smiling extremely brightly.
"Okay, let's get some rest early." Chu Wei shook his head and walked towards his mansion.
"Brother Chu Wei, please go to bed early." Chu Yue waved to Chu Wei with a smile and watched Chu Wei leave.
Chu Wei promised Chu Feng to join the Chu Alliance, which made Chu Yue overjoyed, but she did not see the sinister smile on Chu Wei's lips when he turned around.
"Senior Sister Chu Yue, the one named Chu Feng is well hidden. I have been in the outer sect for so long, but I have never heard of his name. It seems that he is rushing to get the first place in the inner sect's assessment."
At this moment, a young man walked over. Like Chu Feng, he was a new disciple this year and had just joined the Chu League today.
"You are right. Brother Chu Feng must have stayed in the outer sect for the reward of the assessment. I don't know if he got it or not." After hearing what he said, Chu Yue also suddenly realized.
"Senior Sister Chu Yue, you are overthinking. A ruthless character appeared in the outer sect this year, and that person took it away early in the morning."
"Although your Chu Feng brother is not bad in terms of strength, compared with that person, he is simply inferior." The young man said with a smile.
"A ruthless character? How ruthless?" Chu Yue was curiousasked.
"That was quite cruel. One fourth-level ferocious beast, nine third-level ferocious beasts, and thirty second-order ferocious beasts were all slaughtered by him in the blink of an eye."
"When those talented disciples from the outer sect arrived, all they saw were the corpses of ferocious beasts all over the ground. With such strength, do you think they are ruthless or not?"
"So powerful?" At this moment, Chu Yue's face was also full of shock.
She is also someone who has experienced the inner sect's assessment. She knows how powerful the machine formation is, and she also knows how terrifying the ferocious beast is.
And before everyone arrived, it was enough to kill so many ferocious beasts. She could fully imagine how powerful this person was, and it would require at least the fifth level of spiritual martial arts to do it.
"What's that person's name?" After being shocked, Chu Yue wanted to know the name of this ruthless character.
"Hey, I also want to know who he is."
"But unfortunately, that person deliberately concealed his identity. After taking the reward, he left without saying anything.
"Then this person is really strange. He is so powerful and yet so low-key. Does he have some ulterior secret? "
At this moment, Chu Yue became more and more curious about the so-called ruthless character.
